notes: The Kid's dedication to Francis L. is verbatim on Wikiquote. Billy Sparks owns First Avenue (Wikipedia plot and cast; Ultimate Prince calls the owner Jimmy, Wikipedia is used). The puppet is a monkey puppet (Ultimate Prince). Lake Minnetonka, the password routine, keep the change, Morris's mirror and Jungle Love on Ultimate Prince. Apollonia 6, three house band slots, Slow Groove tape, the box of songs and the motorcycle on Wikipedia. House popcorn 'Morris will want a mirror.' is not printed and is ok.

vibe.verdict: First Avenue with The Kid's dedication, Lake Minnetonka, the password and Morris's keep-the-change is very close to the film; the food is invented and the small logo repeats the poster's title.
